question: Will the Strait of Hormuz reopen this month, yes or no?

lines.text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say four oil tankers hit naval mines near the Strait of Hormuz.
The Guards say the tankers took a prohibited route south of the strait, and are still ablaze.
They say two more vessels were detained for breaking shipping restrictions.
The claims could not be independently verified, IntelliNews says.
Tehran wants ships to use a northern lane through Iranian waters instead, IntelliNews says.
Separately, UKMTO says two projectiles hit a tanker's engine room off Limah, Oman, on Tuesday. No casualties were reported.
It is unclear whether the two incidents are linked, Al Jazeera says.
The Guards also say they shot down a US MQ-9 drone, their fifty-sixth.
Before the war, about one hundred and forty ships a day crossed. Now it is fewer than ten, IntelliNews says.
Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei said: America's response to Iran's rights and demands was not convincing.
